scope.source: existing private replay manifest and lightweight experiment result records

outcome_conditioned_stage_proxy_counts.positive_control_warning: The approach proxy (end-effector-to-bowl distance <= 0.05 m) is present in only 5/14 successful traces, while later grasp/lift/transport/placement proxies are present in 13/14, 14/14, 14/14, and 14/14. Therefore this approach threshold is not a valid necessary predecessor for successful stage classification in this replay; the nine failure labels of approach are not causal findings.
outcome_conditioned_stage_proxy_counts.interpretation_limit: Preserve the predeclared threshold and observed counts; do not retrospectively tune the threshold against these outcomes. Stage proxies are descriptive and cannot identify policy causality or separate policy limits from simulator variability.

data_or_conversion_pipeline_defect.supporting_checks: Official HDF5 provenance/hash and the independent/pooled conversion audits passed; task-0 frame/state/action/RGB parity and filtered-loader schema checks passed before training.
data_or_conversion_pipeline_defect.limit: These checks do not prove every training-time behavior correct, but no concrete conversion or evaluator defect is identified by current evidence.

single_task_optimization_or_training_exp.evidence: The current-recipe single-task 40k checkpoint scored 11/20 paired and 3/5 fixed-init3; available single init3 checkpoint probes show a 10k failure and 20k/30k successes, but each checkpoint probe is one rollout and is not a success-rate estimate.
single_task_optimization_or_training_exp.limit: The full learning curve has not been audited; the small rollout sample and failed stage-proxy positive control prevent attributing the result to insufficient training.

multi_task_interference.evidence: On 20 paired task-0 initializations, current-recipe single-task was 11/20 and matched joint-4 was 14/20; discordant counts were single-only 1 and joint-4-only 4 (exact two-sided McNemar p=0.375). Fixed-init3 was 3/5 versus 4/5, with only five repeated rollouts.
multi_task_interference.limit: These small samples neither show a joint-4 harm nor establish equivalence; no causal no-interference claim is warranted.

options_compared.option: Treat nine approach labels as proof of approach-stage policy failure
options_compared.reason: The approach proxy misses 9/14 successful traces even though later stage events and official success occur; the positive-control validity condition fails.

options_compared.option: Retrospectively change proxy thresholds or rerun the same 24 traces
options_compared.reason: Post-hoc threshold tuning would be outcome leakage, and an identical replay adds no information or repairs the proxy definition. Preserve the completed artifacts unchanged.

options_compared.option: Immediately extend/repeat training or scale to eight tasks
options_compared.reason: Current task-0 fixed-init3 repeatability is 3/5, below the registered 5/5 gate; task scaling is not authorized. More training has no registered falsifiable contrast yet.

options_compared.option: Review full existing learning-curve/checkpoint evidence and register a future matched falsifiable contrast only after instrument positive controls are validated
options_compared.reason: This uses existing evidence first, avoids duplicate compute, and separates what is currently known about data flow, optimization, and task interference without changing the failed gate.

next_action: Keep 8/16/32-task scaling and Fold02 locked. First audit the full existing training curve and checkpoint probes read-only, then prepare (but do not launch) a protocol that validates every stage proxy on independent successful controls before comparing failures. Any new training or policy rollout requires a separately reviewed hypothesis, unique output roots, and explicit authorization.
